stories.title: La 'bolamanía' se desata en San Sebastián, que se rinde ante el fenómeno de los Javis

en.title: 'Bola-mania' breaks out in San Sebastián, which surrenders to the Los Javis phenomenon
en.summary: The Spanish film 'La bola negra' by Los Javis continues gaining momentum after winning the audience prize at the Toronto Film Festival. The filmmakers celebrated the award with actress Penélope Cruz.

stories.title: Evenepoel revalida su arcoíris y es por cuarta vez consecutiva campeón mundial contrarreloj

en.title: Evenepoel defends his rainbow jersey and becomes four-time consecutive world time trial champion
en.summary: Belgian cyclist Remco Evenepoel won his fourth consecutive world championship in the time trial discipline. Spanish cyclist Iván Romeo achieved the best result for Spain in 15th place.

stories.title: Otro mordisco mundial del 'Pitbull': Evenepoel gana su cuarto arcoíris consecutivo en contrarreloj

en.title: Another world bite from 'Pitbull': Evenepoel wins his fourth consecutive rainbow jersey in time trial
en.summary: Remco Evenepoel won the elite men's time trial at the 2026 World Cycling Championship held in Montreal. The Belgian cyclist dominated the course to secure a historic fourth consecutive world title.

stories.title: Rusia vota al partido de Putin mientras Ucrania lanza su “mayor ataque” a Moscú

en.title: Russia votes for Putin's party while Ukraine launches its "biggest attack" on Moscow
en.summary: Ukrainian drones caused three deaths in the region surrounding the Russian capital during military operations. The incidents occurred as Russia held voting for Putin's political party.

stories.title: Putin finiquita unas elecciones plagadas de irregularidades y abre un nuevo capítulo de la guerra

en.title: Putin concludes elections plagued by irregularities and opens a new chapter of war
en.summary: Russia's ruling party secured 57% of votes in elections marked by irregularities, with only the government having access to the electronic voting system. The vote represents a significant political development amid ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Rajada histórica de Mourinho: «Enhorabuena al Comité Arbitral»

en.title: Historic outburst from Mourinho: "Congratulations to the Arbitration Committee"
en.summary: Mourinho criticized referee decisions in a match, presenting photographic evidence of two incidents he deemed clear red cards. He expressed frustration about the impact of playing with numerical disadvantage during the contest.

stories.title: El partido de Vladimir Putin se impone en unas elecciones sin oposición real

en.title: Vladimir Putin's party wins elections without real opposition
en.summary: The government-aligned party obtained 57.54% of votes according to initial results from the electoral commission in elections lacking substantial political opposition.

stories.title: Los Javis vibran con Lorca y convierten al poeta en fenómeno de masas en San Sebastián y en Toronto

en.title: Los Javis electrify with Lorca and turn the poet into a mass phenomenon in San Sebastián and Toronto
en.summary: The film "La bola negra" premiered in Spain with unprecedented enthusiasm, having won awards at Cannes and Toronto festivals. The movie has been selected for Oscar consideration.

stories.title: Ya está aquí Mourinho: “Quien tiene que estar feliz es el comité de designación arbitral”

en.title: Mourinho is here: "Those who should be happy are the referee appointment committee"
en.summary: Real Madrid's coach criticized the referee, VAR, and those responsible for officiating after a match, claiming two red cards should have been issued against Atlético.

stories.title: Mourinho, desatado en rueda de prensa tras el derbi: "La historia del partido está en estas fotos. Enhorabuena al Comité de Árbitros"

en.title: Mourinho unleashed at press conference after the derby: "The story of the match is in these photos. Congratulations to the Referees Committee"
en.summary: The Portuguese coach criticized the referee and VAR official following a loss at Metropolitano, expressing disappointment that the league had not changed since his previous departure.

stories.title: Moscú denuncia "el mayor ataque de la historia" por parte de Ucrania contra la capital, que deja al menos dos muertos y varios heridos

en.title: Moscow denounces "the greatest attack in history" by Ukraine against the capital, leaving at least two dead and several wounded
en.summary: Russian Defense Ministry stated it intercepted 1,100 Ukrainian drones across the country, with 450 over Moscow, resulting in casualties during an attack on the capital.

stories.title: Ucrania lanza su mayor ataque sobre Moscú en el último día de elecciones rusas

en.title: Ukraine launches its largest attack on Moscow on the final day of Russian elections
en.summary: Ukraine carried out a major attack on Moscow during Russian elections, with President Zelenski acknowledging the offensive while calling for Russia to end the war and pursue peace.

stories.title: Volvo Cars nombra a Klaus Zellmer futuro presidente y CEO de la compañía sueca

en.title: Volvo Cars appoints Klaus Zellmer as future president and CEO of the Swedish company
en.summary: Klaus Zellmer, current CEO of Skoda Auto, will replace Hakan Samuelsson as head of Geely-owned Volvo Cars, with the transition occurring by October 1, 2027 at the latest.

stories.title: España recurre a las redes sociales para desalentar las entradas irregulares a Ceuta y Melilla

en.title: Spain uses social media to discourage irregular entries to Ceuta and Melilla
en.summary: Spain is running a social media campaign informing people that entering Ceuta and Melilla irregularly does not grant the right to access mainland Spain, remain in the country, or freely travel within the European Union.

stories.title: Meloni anuncia una ley para limitar el número de extranjeros por aula en los colegios

en.title: Meloni announces law to limit number of foreigners per classroom in schools
en.summary: Italian Prime Minister Meloni announced that a draft law to restrict the number of foreign students in school classrooms will be presented at the next Council of Ministers.

stories.title: Trump anuncia que creará la 'Fuerza IA' y nombrará un 'zar' para dirigirla

en.title: Trump announces he will create 'AI Force' and appoint a 'czar' to lead it
en.summary: Trump announced plans to establish an artificial intelligence force and designate a leader to oversee it.

stories.title: La inteligencia artificial destapa trabajos sin sentido que estaban ocultos

en.title: Artificial intelligence uncovers meaningless jobs that were hidden
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is revealing unnecessary tasks embedded within legitimate professions, eliminating busywork rather than eliminating essential jobs themselves.
